title: Engine frame rate limiter active (headroom available)
fix_rationale: Frame limiter sleep indicates the engine intentionally throttled execution to match target framerate; this represents available performance headroom.
evidence_template: The engine spent {ms} ms sleeping inside {timer} to adhere to frame rate limits.

fixes.text: If higher framerates are desired, adjust t.MaxFPS or Project Frame Rate settings.

verify: Verify that increasing t.MaxFPS increases measured FPS without bottlenecks.
caveats: This is informational and indicates healthy frame rate limiting.
